_comment: MIS-138 D1.1 — the classifiers the guards and the telemetry instrument share. Data, not code: any language reads this file. Each block names the ruling it transcribes; change the ruling, change the block, every consumer follows. Before 2026-09-02 three private copies of `series` and three of `apparatus` lived in count-evidence.py, lint-naming.mjs and lint-frontmatter.mjs and drifted (CHANGELOG 2026-09-02, naming-baseline 2 → 0).

series._comment: ADR-005 v1.2.0 register, by top-level directory. `prefix` may list alternatives. `dailyDate`: RPT-YYYY-MM-DD is legal for `subtype: daily` only (ADR-004 rule 3). history/ and agents/ deliberately absent (ADR-035 §2; ADR-005 v1.1.0 reversal). `naming`: false = no filename scheme is enforced (agents/ is folder-named but its frontmatter id is still checked: none legal).

retiredPrefixes._comment: Prefixes that no longer name a series but still appear in prose and must resolve for reference checking (check-references ID_RE). D- closed 2026-08-31 (RPT-001 §12).

apparatus._comment: D-014: scaffolding around a series, not a member of it. A document is apparatus if `type: meta`, or its basename is listed here, or its path matches a pattern. lint-naming, lint-frontmatter (IS_TEMPLATE) and count-evidence each held a partial copy of this list.

types._comment: STD-004 §4 H-03 closed type vocabulary; H-17 type ↔ series, strict except `lax`.

subtypes._comment: STD-004 §4 H-18; `report` closed since ADR-005 v1.2.0.

governed._comment: STD-004 §8: the top-level directories whose tracked .md files lint-frontmatter governs. Everything else (web/, scripts/, root, .github/) is out of its scope.
